system.name: TRACE
system.one_liner: Finds the denoising step where instances separate in a diffusion model's self-attention, extracts edges from it, and distils them into a one-step edge decoder.

content.variant_note: (a) the phenomenon on a two-cats example at four timesteps, self- versus cross-attention; (b) the method on a dog photo with its three named stages
content.argues: Instance structure shows up in self-attention at particular diffusion steps, not in cross-attention, and TRACE picks that step, extracts edges and distils them into cleaner boundaries.
content.subject: Attention-map tiles of one image across diffusion timesteps in the reverse and forward process, and TRACE's three steps that turn them into instance edges.

lessons.what_to_learn: Show a phenomenon as a grid of per-timestep tiles (rows = map type, columns = timestep), mark the first timestep where it appears with a coloured frame and a dashed box, then reuse the same tile grammar for the method so the green stage names attach to the exact tile and edge maps they act on.
lessons.suits: Iterative or diffusion-based methods where an observation at certain steps motivates a step-selection and extraction pipeline, with intermediate maps as the content.

evidence: cross-attention remains semantic even with the prompt, whereas self-attention at specific steps reveals instance-level structure
TRACE selects the instance-emergent step using a temporal divergence criterion
these edges are distilled into a one-step predictor that integrates the diffusion backbone with an edge decoder

summary: TRACE decodes instance boundaries from a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model by finding the denoising step at which instances separate in self-attention. Figure 1 has two lettered halves. (a) Observation: a red 'Reverse Process' arrow turns a noise tile into a two-cats image, and two rows of attention maps at four timesteps show cross-attention staying semantic while self-attention at tau = 699 splits the cats, marked by a yellow frame, a dashed white box and red 'Temporal Difference' arrows. (b) TRACE: a green 'Forward Process' arrow takes a dog photo to noise; the self-attention tile at tau = 399 is tagged 'Instance Emergence Point', passed through Attention Boundary Divergence to an initial edge map with red crosses, then One-step Edge Distillation to a refined map with green circles.
summary_zh: TRACE 从文生图扩散模型的自注意力中解码实例边界。(a) 观察：红色反向过程里交叉注意力偏语义，自注意力在 τ=699 分开两只猫；(b) 绿色正向过程找到实例涌现点，经注意力边界散度得初始边缘，再一步蒸馏出更连贯的边缘。
notes: Prior kinds kept and stage-pipeline added for the three named stages in (b); subfield order changed to vision first because the task is instance segmentation and edges. The meaning of the red crosses and green circles is read from the drawing only. Tiles are 18 placed bitmaps (the noise image is reused), all 43 x 43 pt.
